name: Filter slot: every track runs, after Volume + Dist, the filter its sound chose among the build's, its values on RETRIG + a knob
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (the track filters, notes/72): built once into fltslot.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build in which a package is a filter, always with the shortcut layer. The audio block's call of Volume + Dist (0x40059852) goes to the part, which runs it, then filters each track whose sound chose a filter of the build (the low byte of its k 32: 0 none, then the filters by id) with the track's smoothed k 28 to k 31, and fades from one filter to the other across the block when a track changes filter. A track whose sound chose none, or an id the build does not hold, is not touched. Since 0.2 (the key map's RETRIG level) the filters' values are real parameters of every machine, descriptors 1 to 4 on k 28 to k 31, written before the OS builds its parameter tables at boot (0x4004486c): RETRIG + SWEEP, CONTOUR, COLOR or SHAPE in ParameterPageView's knob lookup (0x401005a8, in front of the shortcut layer's), with p-locks, LFO, velocity, CC 74 and 71; RETRIG + PITCH steps the selected track's sound through none and the build's filters (descriptor 5, display only, taken at the encoder handler's question for TRACK, 0x4001f886, in front of the effect slots' gesture); the pattern's p-locks of k 23 and above go back to their parameter (0x4005b998, 0x4005baca, 0x4005aa34, the track filter's fix of notes/47 §4.3). Since 0.3 the sound record functions (0x4005afa0, 0x4005b054, 0x4005aecc) go to the part in front of the shortcut layer's wrappers: the values are stored relative to their neutral word (XOR), the ones no filter of the build declares as their neutral, and the LFO's and velocity's destinations on a value in record slot 18, bits 10-15, with none where the OS keeps them. Since 0.4 LFO + RETRIG + SWEEP / CONTOUR / COLOR / SHAPE makes the value the LFO's destination: that gesture (0x4001eaa2) reads the machine record's knob list, not the knob lookup, and the part answers there too (0x4001ead8). Since 0.5 the part times itself (the DMA timer 0) and keeps its load's average and peak over windows of 0.5 s; a measuring build (compose.py --diag-filters) shows them in Filter Cutoff's and the type's popups. Since 0.6 Filter Cutoff reads -64 .. 0 .. 63, as SAMPLE's (L64 .. OFF .. H63 before). Since 0.7 (the Track FX of notes/73: the slot holds effects as well as filters) a build holds four, the table one entry longer and the data block 804 bytes, and the type's row reads Track FX (Filter Type before). Since 0.8 each filter declares its values' start words (params[].start, else the neutral word): a step of the type to a filter gives the sound those that differ from the neutral words when it comes from none, all of them when it comes from another filter, in the sound and in the audio's targets of the tracks that play it (0x800015ae). The composer writes the data block right after the part's code.

gestures.meaning: the track filter's values: Cutoff, Reso, Env depth, AD
the sound's filter: none or one of the build's
the track filter's value becomes the LFO's destination
